entries.wording: 包裹已揽收，正在安排出库，快递高峰期如有延误请谅解【…】
entries.note: Huaxia's first scan, at its Richmond office.

entries.wording: 已出库，送至温哥华机场，等待航班起飞 【…】
航班起飞，温哥华 - 中国 【…】
到达口岸清关中，请耐心等待 【…】
entries.note: Landed at the Chinese port, in import clearance.

entries.wording: 清关完成，转交快递派送，感谢您的耐心等待 【…】
entries.note: Cleared and handed to the domestic courier: not out for delivery.

entries.wording: 顺丰速运 已收取快件，…
entries.note: SF's first scan, after customs: the hand-over, not the parcel's acceptance.

entries.wording: 快件在【…】完成分拣，准备发往 【…】
快件离开 【…】，已在发往 【…】 的路上
您的快件运输时经过…，遇当地交通管制，…
entries.note: A delay notice during the trip: not a movement, so the row keeps the stage of the one before it.

entries.wording: 我们正在为您的快件分配最合适的快递员，请您稍等
entries.note: A notice at the delivery station before a courier takes the parcel: not a movement.

entries.wording: 快件交给，正在派送途中
entries.note: The adapter drops the courier's name and phone that SF writes after 交给.
The adapter drops where the parcel was left and the courier's contact after it. The record's STATE 3 says delivered too.
